newsitem.title: UK: Amersham up after paper gives buy signal.
newsitem.headline: Amersham up after paper gives buy signal.

text.p: Shares in Amersham International rose early on Monday after a newspaper report said the company looked good value, quoting an analyst as saying this year's profits could rise to 66.5 million stg from 50.8 million in 1995.
The shares were up 16p at 11.12-1/2 stg by 0910 GMT.
The Independent on Sunday said the outlook for the radioactivity and healthcare company was encouraging, with diagnostic products and life sciences doing particularly well.
The paper also pointed to a deal with Sumitomo to merge the Japanese company's nuclear medicine business with Amersham's much smaller operation there.
Another positive sign was new drugs in the pipeline, including agents to diagnose Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's and cancer, it said.
